title: Interior PMSM
text: Three-phase interior permanent magnet synchronous motor with sinusoidal back electromotive force, 3 inputs, 4 outputs; {Mechanical input configuration} selects port configuration, {Simulation type} selects simulation type, {Sample Time (Ts)} sets the sample time for discrete integration, {Number of pole pairs (P)} sets the pole pairs, {Stator resistance per phase (Rs)} sets the resistance .2, {Stator d-axis and q-axis inductance (Ldq)} sets the inductance, {Permanent flux linkage constant (lambda_pm)} sets the flux, {Back-emf constant (Ke)} sets the back electromotive force, {Physical inertia, viscous damping, static friction (mechanical)} sets the inertia, damping, friction, {Initial d-axis and q-axis current (idq0)} sets the current, {Initial mechanical position (theta_init)} sets the angle and {Initial mechanical speed (omega_init)} sets the speed. Values come from the instance.
